name: Just Be Kind Give a Dog a Bean (290 g tray)
note: Complete vegan wet food for adult dogs (faba bean protein, carrots, sweet potato, pumpkin seeds, green beans, papaya, safflower oil, blueberries, kidney beans, sunflower seeds, quinoa, kale, minerals, hemp seeds, psyllium, algae, inulin, chamomile; no soya, pea protein, yeast or grains). From label (as fed): moisture 79%, protein 6.3%, fat 3.7%, crude fibre 1%, ash 1.5%, 90 kcal/100 g. Ca 0.18% and P 0.16% from the justbekind.co.uk product page. Na, K, Mg not declared - ask info@justbekind.co.uk. Vitamins D3, E, B1, B2, B6, folic acid, B12, niacin are the ADDED amounts only (ingredients add a little more). Contains algae; EPA+DHA not stated. Also adds taurine, L-carnitine, zinc 25 mg/kg, copper, iodine, selenium (label says 0.08 g/kg - surely 0.08 mg), DL-methionine 2.2 g/kg (urine-acidifying) and tryptophan. Label: 2 trays/day for 6-10 kg.
